criteria: Score production impact over tutorial projects. A single complex production system beats many CRUD apps. Public OSS is a bonus, not a requirement — private enterprise work counts when described with concrete systems, scale, and failure modes. Do not punish missing GitHub. Links and repos that can be checked beat claims.
notes: Outbound / engineer hire rubric. Ignore school name, GPA, city. Rank only. Do not auto-reject. Personal repos are not OSS.

high_bar.production: Named production systems, scale, and failure modes. Years in prod, not intern tutorials.
high_bar.systems_design: Reliability/architecture judgment: failover, backups, automation, cost, or incident handling.
high_bar.code_quality: Verifiable work: repo, PR, or internal system described well enough to check. Empty GitHub is a gap, not a fail.
high_bar.technical_skills: Languages and tooling shown in production bullets, not a dump.
high_bar.communication: Clear written technical communication in the resume itself.

pass_moves: One production system bullet with scale + failure mode
Fill GitHub or portfolio with 1-2 real automations, or omit both
Keep early ops career visible under later leadership titles
Do not hide work behind VP/strategy language if applying as an engineer
